title: Add NTDS object sid to x509 ASN
description:
- Add szOID_NTDS_CA_SECURITY_EXT OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.25.2
- Add szOID_NTDS_OBJECTSID OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.25.2.1

In accordance with https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-wcce/e563cff8-1af6-4e6f-a655-7571ca482e71

The intent is to parse out the SID as a readable string instead of using the OCTET STRING.

This is to resolve the following Wireshark warning:

```
Extension (iso.3.6.1.4.1.311.25.2)
    Extension Id: 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.25.2 (iso.3.6.1.4.1.311.25.2)
    BER: Dissector for OID not implemented. Contact Wireshark developers if you want this supported
        [Expert Info (Warning/Undecoded): BER: Dissector for OID not implemented. Contact Wireshark developers if you want this supported]
            [BER: Dissector for OID not implemented. Contact Wireshark developers if you want this supported]
            [Severity level: Warning]
            [Group: Undecoded]
```

Blank line removed. Since `packet-cms.c` is an automatically generated file from asn2wrs.py do we know why the extra line was generated?
Yes, this is from `packet-cms-template.c`. This is fixed in master, should be gone if you rebase.
